NAME: Timers and watchdog verification plan
details: Source: GARUDA-TIMERS-SPEC-001, section 2 (requirements), section 10 (assertions) and section 11 (verification plan), written with the specification. Moved into vPlanner form on 2026-10-04; section 4 holds what the 2026-10-04 flow run added.

NAME: Requirements
details: From section 2 of the specification; planned tests from section 11.

NAME: R-1 64-bit monotonic mtime counter readable by firmware.
details: 64-bit monotonic mtime counter, readable by firmware.
implementation_note: Source: Priv spec

NAME: t_mtime_count
details: Oracle: increments every cycle; 32-bit boundary crossing Coverage goal: low-word wrap
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: PARTLY IMPLEMENTED - tb/timers/tb_timers.sv crosses the low-word carry at 16 offsets in [N-7.5] (1 check, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression); there is no check that mtime advances by one every hclk.

NAME: t_mtime_write
details: Oracle: write takes effect immediately
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: PARTLY IMPLEMENTED - tb/timers/tb_timers.sv writes MTIME (task set_time) to place the counter before the carry and mtip checks, which pass only if the write took effect; there is no check of its own.

NAME: R-2 64-bit mtimecmp writable by firmware.
details: 64-bit mtimecmp, writable by firmware.
implementation_note: Source: Priv spec

NAME: t_mtimecmp_rw
details: Oracle: both halves readable and writable
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: PARTLY IMPLEMENTED - tb/timers/tb_timers.sv reads both halves at reset ([N-6.1], 2 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression) and writes them in every mtip check; there is no read-back after a write.

NAME: R-3 mtip shall be delivered to the core as a single wire.
details: mtip shall be delivered to the core as a single wire.
implementation_note: Source: ADR-0010

NAME: t_mtip_single_wire
details: Oracle: mtip reaches mip.MTIP; no CLIC ID involved
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: sw/tests/t_mtip.S on tb/soc/tb_boot.v (sim/sanity/t_mtip.log: TOHOST=1 PASSED): mtip alone wakes the core through mip.MTIP. At chip level sw/chip/t_chip_irq.c and t_chip_integ.c take the machine-timer interrupt with no CLIC ID (RESULT: PASSED).

NAME: R-4 A 32-bit read of mtime s halves shall never return a torn value.
details: A 32-bit read of mtime's halves shall never return a torn value.
implementation_note: Source: Priv spec

NAME: t_mtime_coherent
details: Oracle: read LO then HI across a carry returns the right value Coverage goal: carry at the exact read cycle
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: tb/timers/tb_timers.sv, check [N-7.5] LO-then-HI read is coherent across a carry, 16 offsets - 1 check, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: t_mtime_hi_alone
details: Oracle: reading HI alone returns the shadow, documented as such
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: NOT IMPLEMENTED - no check reads MTIME_HI without a preceding MTIME_LO read in tb/timers/tb_timers.sv.

NAME: R-5 Writing mtimecmp shall not produce a spurious mtip.
details: Writing mtimecmp shall not produce a spurious mtip.
implementation_note: Source: Priv spec

NAME: t_mtimecmp_seq
details: Oracle: the three-step sequence produces no spurious mtip
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: PARTLY IMPLEMENTED - tb/timers/tb_timers.sv uses the three-step sequence for every compare write (task set_cmp) and checks mtip low before the deadline afterwards (1 check, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression); there is no test named for the sequence.

NAME: t_mtimecmp_naive
details: Oracle: the naive one-step write does produce a spurious mtip, confirming why the sequence is required
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: NOT IMPLEMENTED - the one-step write is not exercised in tb/timers/tb_timers.sv.

NAME: R-6 32-bit watchdog with a programmable timeout and a magic-value ...
details: 32-bit watchdog with a programmable timeout and a magic-value kick.
implementation_note: Source: Safety

NAME: t_wdt_count
details: Oracle: counts down, kicks reload, zero asserts the request
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: tb/timers/tb_timers.sv, checks [N-7.17] WDTVAL reads WDTLOAD while disabled, [N-6.4] a kick reloads, and the request at expiry ([R-8]) - 3 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: t_wdt_magic
details: Oracle: only 0x5A5A_C3C3 kicks; sweep of other values Coverage goal: ≥100 random values
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: PARTLY IMPLEMENTED - tb/timers/tb_timers.sv tries one wrong value (0x1234_5678) and the magic value ([N-6.4], 1 check, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression); the sweep of 100 or more values in the plan is not run.

NAME: R-7 The watchdog shall raise an interrupt before it resets so ...
details: The watchdog shall raise an interrupt before it resets, so firmware can record why.
implementation_note: Source: Safety

NAME: t_wdt_warn
details: Oracle: warning fires at the threshold, before the reset Coverage goal: 3 threshold values
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: PARTLY IMPLEMENTED - tb/timers/tb_timers.sv checks one threshold: [N-6.6] the warning asserts at WDTVAL <= WDTWARN, D-17 it stays asserted, and it is cleared by the reset (3 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression); the plan asks for 3 threshold values.

NAME: R-8 The watchdog s reset request shall not be cleared by the reset it ...
details: The watchdog's reset request shall not be cleared by the reset it causes.
implementation_note: Source: ADR-0003

NAME: t_wdt_req_survives
details: Oracle: request holds through hreset_n; full-length reset results
implementation_note: Status in the specification: critical, new. Bench: tb/timers/tb_timers.sv, checks t_wdt_req_survives, [R-8] [N-7.21] the request is still asserted when hreset_n falls, [N-7.21] reset length and request cleared, stretched reset, [N-7.22] RSTREASON = WDT - 6 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression. The whole chain is also run in sw/chip/t_chip_wdt.c (RESULT: PASSED).

NAME: R-9 The watchdog shall not be disableable once enabled.
details: The watchdog shall not be disableable once enabled.
implementation_note: Source: Safety

NAME: t_wdt_no_disable
details: Oracle: no write clears EN
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: tb/timers/tb_timers.sv, check [N-6.2] WDTCTL.EN is sticky: writing 0 does not clear it - 1 check, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: Planned tests not tied to one requirement
t_mtip_late_write
details: Oracle: mtimecmp set to a past value asserts mtip immediately
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: tb/timers/tb_timers.sv, check [N-7.9] a deadline already passed asserts at once - 1 check, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: t_wdt_during_hartreset
details: Oracle: watchdog fires while the core is debug-held, as documented
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: NOT IMPLEMENTED - tb/timers/tb_timers.sv declares the hartreset request (hart_req) but never drives it.

NAME: t_timers_1khz
details: Oracle: full 1 kHz loop with the real reload value, 1000 iterations, no drift
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: NOT IMPLEMENTED - no 1 kHz loop with the real reload value in tb/timers/tb_timers.sv or in sw/chip.

NAME: Assertions
details: From section 10 of the specification.

NAME: a_mtime_monotonic
details: mtime is monotonic except on an explicit write
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. NOT IMPLEMENTED - named in the specification only; no monitor of mtime in tb/timers/tb_timers.sv.

NAME: a_mtip_correct
details: mtip is exactly the comparison (R-3, N-7.8)
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. NOT IMPLEMENTED as SVA. Checked procedurally in tb/timers/tb_timers.sv ([N-7.8], [N-7.9], [N-7.10]).

NAME: a_mtip_level
details: mtip is level, not a pulse: it holds until mtimecmp advances
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. NOT IMPLEMENTED as SVA. Checked procedurally in tb/timers/tb_timers.sv ([N-7.10] mtip clears only when mtimecmp is written past mtime).

NAME: a_mtimecmp_reset
details: mtimecmp resets to all-ones so mtip cannot assert at reset (N-6.1)
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. NOT IMPLEMENTED as SVA. Checked procedurally in tb/timers/tb_timers.sv ([N-6.1] MTIMECMP_LO and _HI reset to all ones; mtip low after reset).

NAME: a_shadow_latch
details: coherent read: MTIME_HI returns the shadow, never the live value (R-4)
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. NOT IMPLEMENTED as SVA. Checked procedurally in tb/timers/tb_timers.sv ([N-7.5] LO-then-HI read is coherent across a carry).

NAME: a_hi_returns_shadow
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. NOT IMPLEMENTED - only the LO-then-HI read is checked ([N-7.5]); see t_mtime_hi_alone.

NAME: a_wdt_req_survives_hreset
details: THE watchdog domain property (R-8, N-7.19)
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. NOT IMPLEMENTED as SVA. Checked procedurally in tb/timers/tb_timers.sv ([R-8] [N-7.21] the request is still asserted at the instant hreset_n falls; t_wdt_req_survives).

NAME: a_wdt_req_cleared_only_by_ctrl
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. NOT IMPLEMENTED as SVA. Checked procedurally in tb/timers/tb_timers.sv ([N-7.21] request cleared once the reset was in force).

NAME: a_wdt_en_sticky
details: watchdog enable is sticky (R-9, N-6.2)
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. NOT IMPLEMENTED as SVA. Checked procedurally in tb/timers/tb_timers.sv ([N-6.2]).

NAME: a_wdt_magic_only
details: only the magic value kicks (N-6.5)
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. NOT IMPLEMENTED as SVA. Checked procedurally in tb/timers/tb_timers.sv ([N-6.4], one wrong value).

NAME: a_wdt_magic_reloads
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. NOT IMPLEMENTED as SVA. Checked procedurally in tb/timers/tb_timers.sv ([N-6.4]).

NAME: a_wdt_stopped
details: the counter only runs when enabled
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. NOT IMPLEMENTED as SVA. Checked procedurally in tb/timers/tb_timers.sv ([N-7.17] WDTVAL reads WDTLOAD while disabled).

NAME: a_wdt_req_at_zero
details: reset request only at zero
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. NOT IMPLEMENTED - tb/timers/tb_timers.sv counts a request rising with a non-zero counter (req_rise_bad) but no check reads the count.

NAME: a_wdt_warn_before_reset
details: the warning precedes the reset (R-7)
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. NOT IMPLEMENTED as SVA. Checked procedurally in tb/timers/tb_timers.sv ([N-6.6] warning, then the reset request, in that order).

NAME: a_wdt_warn_at_thresh
details: warning asserts at exactly the threshold
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. NOT IMPLEMENTED as SVA. Checked procedurally in tb/timers/tb_timers.sv ([N-6.6]) as WDTVAL <= WDTWARN when the warning is seen, not as exactly the threshold.
